01 / Bachelor thesis / 2021

Give a
Transformer
some structure.

Integration and differential equations become sequences. The bachelor thesis asked whether explicit structural information could help Transformers solve them.

The useful result: the structural changes studied did not improve the baseline.

03 / TUM / 2023-2025 / thesis 2025

What can
an agent
forget?

A master's in Mathematics in Data Science at TUM. The thesis investigated implicit context condensation for local software-engineering agents.

The later compression paper reports transfer to single-shot tasks, but failure on the multi-step agentic SWE tasks studied.

04 / Early 2026 / partial research

Which model.
Which step.

Choosing a model at each step of a software-engineering agent: routing signals, cost, exploration and the difficulty of training the router.

An investigation with open difficulties, rather than a claim of a finished routing product.

05 / Budget Internalization / 2026

Learn
the limit.

What happens when a reasoning model learns under a fixed token budget?

The studied training improves accuracy near the cap, but can weaken scaling when more tokens become available. Three small model families; one training seed per condition.
